name: Brazil

nationalGame.name: Football
nationalGame.about: Football is a way of life in Brazil — the country has won the most World Cups ever: five.
nationalGame.note: Brazil has no single official national sport — football is the nation's heart.

loved.name: Football
loved.why: Every beach and street has kids juggling a ball.

loved.name: Capoeira
loved.why: A dance-fight game born in Brazil, with music and flips.

loved.name: Volleyball
loved.why: Brazil's beach volleyball teams are world famous.

fact: Brazil is the only country to have played in every single FIFA World Cup.
